battle.name: 伊斯蘭對波斯的征服
battle.brief: 西元633年阿拉伯軍自巴林入兩河，636年1月於 al-Qadisiyya 擊殺波斯主帥 Rustam，三月陷 Ctesiphon，八月 al-Zab 摧毀中央援軍，642年陷 Dastgerd，薩珊覆亡。卡面羅馬弩砲是扭力攻城投射機，633年已退出一線，決定攻守者為配重投石機、衝撞槌與攻城塔。

kit.name: 羅馬弩砲
kit.history: 扭力弩砲，一發一具箭。羅馬用它拆掉希臘的城牆，也拆掉了希臘的城邦體系。

countries: 交戰的一方是麥地那的阿拉伯政權，即穆罕默德於西元632年去世後由 Abu Bakr 接手、隨後以奧馬爾為哈里發的拉希敦國家。軍隊以阿拉伯諸部族的騎兵為骨幹，步兵為輔，分為阿茲拉克、奧斯、哈茲拉木、基奈卡等部族的分隊，各有各的旗號，並無常備的統一番籍；哈里發國同時在敍利亞與伊拉克設兩個戰區，伊拉克戰區先後由哈立德·伊本·瓦利德與薩德·伊本·阿比·瓦卡斯執掌，戰後由薩德以軍營為基礎築成 al-Hira 與 Basra 的駐地，作為後來的兵站。另一方是薩珊王朝，即以「萬王之王」自居的雅茲底格三世（西元632至642年在位）的波斯帝國；中央有御林軍與四大軍團，邊疆各行省總督與世襲貴族各有私兵，國庫與糧倉集中在兩河下游與波斯高原，稅制與兵役在和平年代已是一套完整的機構。關鍵的波斯指揮官包括御林軍總司令 Rustam Farrokhzad、呼羅珊大貴族 Vahriz、西部的 Narseh，以及巴林總督 Anushirwan。第三方是拜占庭帝國，Heraclius 皇帝於628年議和後放棄美索不達米亞東部與亞美尼亞，但仍在敍利亞與阿拉伯人對峙；薩珊的藩屬萊什王國，其國王 al-Nu'man 既是薩珊的臣屬又與阿拉伯部族有血緣往來，夾在兩強之間為雙方所拉攏。
countriesEn: One side was the Arab polity centred on Medina, the Rashidun state that Abu Bakr took over when Muhammad died in AD 632, and that Umar soon succeeded in leading. Its army had cavalry from the Arab tribal confederations as its backbone and infantry as its support, organised in contingents of the Azraq, Aws, Hazram and Kinah and similar tribes, each with its own banner and without a standing central establishment. The caliphate ran two theatres at once, in Syria and in Iraq, and the Iraqi theatre was commanded first by Khalid ibn al-Walid and then by Sa'd ibn Abi Waqqas, who stayed behind and built the garrison stations of al-Hira and Basra on the model of the army camp, which later became the military bases of the region. The other side was the Sasanian Empire, the Persian state of Yuzdigird III (reigned 632 to 642), which called itself King of Kings; it had a royal guard and four provincial armies in the centre, hereditary nobles and provincial governors with private troops on the frontiers, and a treasury and granaries concentrated in the lower Tigris and on the Iranian plateau, supported by a fully organised system of taxation and conscription even in time of peace. The Persian commanders whose names survive are Rustam Farrokhzad, commander of the royal guard, the great Khurasani noble Vahriz, Narseh in the west, and Anushirwan, the governor of Bahrain. A third party was the Byzantine Empire, which under Heraclius had renounced eastern Mesopotamia and Armenia at the peace of 628 but was still locked in a frontier war in Syria; and the Lakhmid kingdom, a Sasanian vassal whose ruler al-Nu'man was Arab by blood, sat between the two powers and was courted by both.
people: 這場戰爭的關鍵人物分屬兩邊，幾乎每一場決定性的會戰都圍繞一個人的判斷展開。先知穆罕默德在632年6月病逝，他留下的並非一份作戰計劃，而是一份對薩珊君主的呼籲：據編年記載，他曾遣使送書直到泰西封，要求對方接受改信，拒絕者將承受兵禍；正因為他已死，哈里發國才必須在沒有先知在場的情況下決定遠征。承接這項決定的是 Abu Bakr，他以哈里發的身分在634年正式頒下開戰命令，任命哈立德·伊本·瓦利德為伊拉克戰區主將，戰區的行政、糧餉與戰利品分配也逐步授權予他。哈立德是全役在場時間最長的阿拉伯將領，自 al-Hira 出兵，經 Walaja、al-Qadisiyya、al-Nihayyan，一直到 Ctesiphon 陷落與 al-Zab 會戰，都有他的指揮；他因戰功被稱為「真主之劍」，但634年被調往敍利亞戰線，伊拉克的指揮權交給薩德·伊本·阿比·瓦卡斯，此人後來成為第三任哈里發，並主持 Basra 營城的興建。奧馬爾在633年哈立德出發前曾受命督導伊拉克戰事，634年即位後改以監軍身分介入，戰利品的分配與新征服地區的劃分多由他拍板。波斯一方，Rustam Farrokhzad 以御林軍總司令之尊被派往 Basra 方向抵擋，在 al-Qadisiyya 陣亡，頭顱被送到麥地那；Vahriz 統率的中央援軍在 al-Zab 被徹底擊潰後逃往呼羅珊；雅茲底格三世自 Ctesiphon 一路退到 Media、Ray，最後在 Merv 被磨坊主殺死，其子 Peroz 帶著王朝名號在674年被阿拉伯軍打敗，至676年死於呼羅珊，薩珊的正統至此斷絕。
peopleEn: The people who decided this war sit in two groups, and almost every engagement turned on one man's judgement. The Prophet Muhammad died of illness in June 632, and what he left behind was not a war plan but a call addressed to the Sasanian monarch: the chronicles report that he sent letters as far as Ctesiphon demanding submission and promising otherwise the fire of war, and precisely because he was dead the caliphate had to decide on a distant campaign without him in the field. Abu Bakr took that decision, issuing the formal order to invade in 634 and naming Khalid ibn al-Walid commander of the Iraqi theatre, and the administration, pay and distribution of the spoils of that theatre were progressively placed in his hands. Khalid is the commander present for the longest stretch of the whole war: the march out of al-Hira, Walaja, al-Qadisiyya, al-Nihayyan, the fall of Ctesiphon and the battle of the Zab all carry his command; his service earned him the title Sword of God, but in 634 he was transferred to the Syrian front and the Iraqi command passed to Sa'd ibn Abi Waqqas, later the third caliph, who presided over the building of the camp city of Basra. Umar had been charged with the Iraqi war before Khalid set out in 633; once he became caliph in 634 he intervened as supervisor, and the sharing of the plunder and the drawing of the conquered districts were settled by him. On the Persian side, Rustam Farrokhzad was sent in the direction of Basra in his capacity as commander of the royal guard and was killed at al-Qadisiyya; his head was carried to Medina. Vahriz commanded the central relief army destroyed at the Zab and afterwards fled to Khurasan. Yuzdigird III retreated from Ctesiphon through Media and Ray and was finally killed by a miller at Merv; his son Peroz carried the name of the dynasty, was beaten by Arab armies in 674 and was killed in Khurasan in 676, and the legitimacy of the Sasanians ended there.
kits: 卡面這件羅馬弩砲（Scorpio）是羅馬晚期用得最多的投射機：底架上架一組扭力簧束，絞盤拉緊後一次釋放，發出一支大型弩矢，射程可達數百步；羅馬人用同族的 cheiroballista 與 ballista 拆城牆，也用較輕的 scorpio 壓制野戰中的步兵方陣。但必須把話說清楚：到西元633年，這種羅馬扭力砲在歐洲與近東早已退出一線，東羅馬與薩珊的軍械庫裡常備的是更輕、更便宜、可以由三四人搬運的拉力式投石機，以人力或配重箱驅動，射界與射速都與扭力砲不同；同期沒有任何可靠文獻記載 al-Qadisiyya 或 Dastgerd 的攻防中出現過羅馬弩砲。所以這件兵器在本役的位置，是已退役的技術譜系而不是戰場上的現役裝備：它代表薩珊與阿拉伯雙方攻城技術的共同來源，也就是晚期羅馬—拜占庭的攻城技藝傳統。真正決定 634年 Emesa 圍城與 642年 Dastgerd 攻城結果的，是配重投石機、衝撞槌、雲梯與可移動的攻城塔；薩珊人在614年圍攻 Emesa 時用過移動攻城塔，說明這門技藝在東方並未中斷，只是器材型號換了。阿拉伯步兵裝備以複合弓、長方木盾、長柄矛與刀為主，騎兵用複合弓與標槍；波斯步兵與重騎兵配戴低冠銅片頭盔、鎖子甲下襯的絮甲，手執橢圓形柳條大盾，陣中配置象兵與投射兵器。
kitsEn: The card shows a Roman Scorpio, the torsion missile machine most widely used in the later Roman army: a bundle of twisted skeins mounted on a timber frame, a windlass drawing them tight and released in a single stroke, throwing a single heavy bolt to a range of several hundred paces. The Romans used the heavier cheiroballista and ballista of the same family to breach city walls, and the lighter scorpio to break up infantry columns in the open field. It must be said plainly, however, that by AD 633 this Roman torsion engine had long since left the first line; the arsenals of Byzantium and of Persia held lighter, cheaper traction engines that three or four men could move, driven by muscle or by a counterweight box, with a different range and a much faster rate of fire, and no reliable source places a Roman scorpio in the fighting at al-Qadisiyya or at Dastgerd. The Scorpio's place in this war, then, is that of a retired technological lineage rather than a weapon in service: it stands for the late Roman and Byzantine siegecraft tradition from which both sides drew. What actually decided the siege of Emesa in 634 and the storming of Dastgerd in 642 was the counterweight thrower, the battering ram, the scaling ladder and the movable siege tower; the Sasanians had used a mobile tower against Emesa in 614, so the craft had never died out in the East even as the type of equipment changed. Arab infantry carried composite bows, tall rectangular wooden shields, spears and swords, and their horse was armed with bow and javelin; Persian infantry and heavy cavalry wore low-crowned copper helmets and quilted padding under mail, carried large oval wicker shields, and were drawn up with elephants and missile troops in the line of battle.
tactics: 阿拉伯軍的戰術核心是速度，以及不落地為營。他們沒有像薩珊那樣經營龐大的後勤車隊，沒有常備的攻城器械體系，靠馬匹的補給能力、就地徵發與劫掠維持戰鬥，因此可以連續機動數百公里，並且把戰役拆成一次次對省區總督與地方貴族的孤立打擊，而不是一次決定性的會戰。薩珊軍隊則仍保有晚期羅馬—薩珊式的重裝結構：中央是密集的步兵與槍兵方陣，兩翼是重騎兵，陣中配置象兵與投射兵器，前面由大盾兵與弓箭手展開正面，其後才是縱深。al-Qadisiyya 的過程把兩套邏輯擺在一起看得最清楚：Rustam 以數千騎兵夜襲阿拉伯營寨未能得手，兩軍在底格里斯河與幼發拉底河之間對峙數日；Khalid 讓中央步兵列陣自守、把自己放在最前線承擔第一線壓力，同時把精銳騎兵集中在一處，等波斯左翼壓上之後才以中央反擊配合側翼迂迴。阿拉伯左翼一度被象兵與波斯騎兵衝散，Khalid 隨即以步兵纏住象兵、射擊象夫，再用整齊的步兵線頂住衝鋒；當波斯軍主力集中在左翼時，阿拉伯方從側後切入其被拉長的縱隊，最終使波斯軍崩潰，敗兵在通往底格里斯河窄橋的渡口被大量殺傷。往後的攻城則換成另一套辦法：進軍 Ctesiphon 時用數百艘船隻在底格里斯河上架浮橋，奪取島上的宮殿群；642年 Dastgerd 之圍歷時數月，圍城者築起攻城塔、配備衝撞槌與雲梯，最後以一次總攻拿下內堡。
tacticsEn: The Arab method was speed and a refusal to settle into fixed positions. They operated no great baggage train and no standing train of siege machines, and lived off horses, requisitions and plunder; they could therefore move several hundred kilometres in a campaign, and they broke the war into a series of isolated blows against provincial governors and local nobles rather than a single decisive engagement. The Sasanian army, by contrast, still carried the late Roman and Sasanian heavy structure: a dense front of infantry and pikemen, heavy cavalry on the wings, elephants and missile troops within the body of the host, a frontage of shield-bearers and archers with the depth of the line behind them. The action at al-Qadisiyya shows both logics set against one another most clearly. Rustam's night attack on the Arab camp with several thousand horsemen failed, and the two armies faced each other for days between the Tigris and the Euphrates. Khalid held the centre with his infantry, put himself in the front rank to take the first shock, and massed his best horse in one place, waiting for the Persian left to press forward before counter-attacking from the centre and rolling the flank over. The Arab left was scattered at one point by the elephants and the Persian cavalry; Khalid tied the elephants down with infantry and shot the drivers, then stood with a closed line of infantry until the charge spent itself. When the Persian weight was committed on the left, the Arabs struck the stretched column from the side and rear, and the Persian host broke, the fugglers being cut down in large numbers at the fords and on the narrow bridge across the Tigris. Siege came later by a different route: at Ctesiphon the Tigris was bridged with a pontoon of several hundred boats to take the palace quarter on the island, and at the siege of Dastgerd in 642, which lasted months, the besiegers built towers, brought up rams and ladders, and finished with a general assault on the citadel.
data: 這場戰爭的年表與數目大致可以拼出來。開端是西元633年春天，Ziyad ibn Salih 率軍進入巴林，在 al-Muharraq 擊敗薩珊的守軍，總督 Anushirwan 自盡；同年秋天，Walaja 之戰（記載為西元633年11月6日）是伊拉克境內第一場野戰；此後 al-Qadisiyya 定於西元636年1月11日，阿拉伯軍出戰人數一般記為六千至七千，部分記載連同後援算到一萬二千，薩珊方面主戰兵力常記為三萬，也有把徵召兵計入後寫成十萬；阿拉伯編年記載波斯軍陣亡約三萬、被俘約五千至一萬，現代研究者一般把陣亡人數下修到一萬至兩萬之間。戰場在底格里斯河與幼發拉底河之間，距 al-Hillah 約三十公里、距 Ctesiphon 不足一百公里，Rustam 在此陣亡。al-Nihayyan 之戰在636年2月，接著是3月 Ctesiphon 陷落與 al-Mada'i 宮殿群被掠，5月 Jalula 之戰再敗波斯反攻，8月的 al-Zab 會戰是全役最致命的一役：al-Tabari 記波斯軍十萬、其中騎兵三萬，阿拉伯軍三萬；波斯軍陣亡約五萬至十萬，被俘三萬至四萬，其後 Vahriz 逃往呼羅珊。642年 Dastgerd 淪陷時，圍城軍在當地約兩萬人上下，圍城歷時數月；同年雅茲底格三世在 Merv 被殺，直到651年 Abu Muslim 平定東伊朗與呼羅珊的最後抵抗才告一段落。Ctesiphon 在七世紀中葉的人口估計在十萬以上，其王庫與財貨的數目在阿拉伯編年中寫得極大，當代研究則普遍認為可變現的部分遠低於原始記載。
dataEn: The chronology and the numbers can be roughly assembled. The opening move was in the spring of AD 633, when Ziyad ibn Salih crossed into Bahrain, beat the Sasanian garrison at al-Muharraq and drove the governor Anushirwan to suicide; in the same autumn the battle of Walaja, dated in the sources to 6 November 633, was the first field engagement in Iraq proper. al-Qadisiyya followed on 11 January 636: the Arab force is generally given as six to seven thousand, though some accounts with reinforcements reach twelve thousand, while the Sasanian main force is commonly put at thirty thousand, with other writers counting in levies and giving a hundred thousand. The Arabic chronicles claim about thirty thousand Persian dead and five to ten thousand prisoners; modern work generally lowers the killed to between ten and twenty thousand. The field lay between the Tigris and the Euphrates, some thirty kilometres from al-Hillah and less than a hundred from Ctesiphon, and Rustam died there. al-Nihayyan came in February 636, the fall of Ctesiphon and the sack of the palace quarter at al-Mada'i in March, Jalula in May against the Persian counter-stroke, and the battle of the Zab in August, the deadliest of the war: al-Tabari gives a hundred thousand Persians of whom thirty thousand were horsemen, against thirty thousand Arabs, with fifty to a hundred thousand killed and thirty to forty thousand prisoners; Vahriz escaped to Khurasan. At Dastgerd in 642 the besieging force was of the order of twenty thousand and the blockade ran for months; in the same year Yuzdigird III was killed at Merv, and the last resistance in eastern Iran and Khurasan was not put down until Abu Muslim came in 651. Ctesiphon in the mid seventh century is estimated at over a hundred thousand inhabitants; the size of its treasury is given in the Arabic chronicles in enormous figures, and modern study holds that the realizable part was far smaller than the reported sum.
cause: 打起來的原因可以分成遠近兩層。近因是兩大帝國在二十年消耗戰之後都空虛了。602年開始的拜占庭—薩珊戰爭打了二十六年，Heraclius 皇帝為守住敍利亞的戰線幾次反攻得手，但628年議和時他必須放棄美索不達米亞東部、亞美尼亞與部分敍利亞土地，兩邊的邊軍、稅基與財政都被戰爭榨乾；628年 Khosrow II 被自己兒子殺死，繼位的 Narseh 反過來對拜占庭人示好，進一步撕裂薩珊貴族；Fars 總督 Mazyar 的叛亂到629年才被平定，中央權威在阿拉伯人跨過幼發拉底河之前尚未恢復。遠因則是阿拉伯部族在這兩個帝國的邊境上住了幾百年：他們為薩珊與拜占庭互相提供騎兵、徵召兵與商隊護衛，向雙方交納保護費，也同時是兩國在敵後作戰的先鋒；當兩大帝國都虛弱到無法照顧這批邊民時，部族之間的聯盟便成了唯一還能運作的力量。宗教與政治層面上，穆罕默德自610年起的宣教已把跨越部族邊界的服從關係建立起來，632年他死後這套網絡並未解散，反而成為動員全阿拉伯的基礎；而634年 Abu Bakr 下達的開戰文書，被阿拉伯編年史保存為對薩珊君主的正式宣戰。此外，薩珊帝國在伊拉克的行政與徵稅失序，連同 al-Hira 與巴林的邊境糾紛，給了阿拉伯軍進入兩河下游的直接機會。
causeEn: The reasons divide into a near and a far layer. The near one is that both great empires were hollowed out by a war of attrition lasting twenty years. The Byzantine and Sasanian war that began in 602 ran for twenty-six years; Heraclius counter-attacked repeatedly to hold his line in Syria, but at the peace of 628 he had to give up eastern Mesopotamia, Armenia and part of Syria, and the frontier armies, the tax base and the finances of both sides were drained by the fighting. In 628 Khosrow II was killed by his own son, and the successor Narseh turned friendly towards the Byzantines, splitting the Persian nobility further; the revolt of the governor of Fars, Mazyar, was not suppressed until 629, so that central authority had not yet recovered when the Arabs crossed the Euphrates. The far cause lies in the Arab tribes who had lived for centuries on the frontiers of these two empires: they supplied cavalry, levies and caravan escort to the Sasanians and to Byzantium alike, paid protection money to each, and served as the shock troops of both in the enemy's rear; when neither empire was strong enough to hold its frontier peoples in check, the tribal confederations became the only structures still able to function. On the religious and political plane, the preaching that began in 610 had already built a form of obedience that crossed tribal lines, and this network did not dissolve when Muhammad died in 632 but became the basis of the general mobilisation of the Arabs; and the order of campaign issued by Abu Bakr in 634 is preserved in the Arabic chronicles as a formal declaration of war against the Sasanian monarch. In addition, the breakdown of Sasanian administration and taxation in Iraq, together with the frontier disputes over al-Hira and Bahrain, gave the Arab army its immediate opportunity to enter the lower Euphrates.
impact: 這場戰爭改寫了西元七世紀以後近東的權力版圖。薩珊帝國在642至643年間消失，前朝的領土、稅冊、灌溉系統與官僚傳統被哈里發國家整體接手；哈里發國在七年之內同時拿下薩珊的伊拉克與波斯、拜占庭的敍利亞、巴勒斯坦與埃及，東地中海世界從兩大帝國的拉鋸變成新帝國的獨佔，羅馬與波斯的兩強均衡此後再沒有恢復。波斯人並沒有因此消失：薩珊貴族作為受保護民被徵為文官、將軍與地方稅吏，波斯語進入清真寺、行政文書與醫藥典籍，先知時代的阿拉伯語由此獲得一支會讀會寫的行政語言；伊拉克的灌溉與兩河的稅基則讓新政權在幾年之內具備支付常備軍與攻城器械的財力。技術上更值得留意的是攻城能力的累積：阿拉伯軍在634年 Emesa、641至642年 Dastgerd 一連串圍城中系統性地取得並使用攻城塔、衝撞槌、配重投石機與雲梯，這套由被俘的拜占庭與薩珊工匠、聶斯脫利派基督徒工程師傳授的技藝，最終在717至718年的君士坦丁堡圍城戰中成熟，並成為後來伊斯蘭世界攻城術的源頭。對拜占庭而言，失去美索不達米亞與敍利亞意味著稅基與兵源被切斷，Heraclius 那個「神聖羅馬皇帝」的帝國在西元630年代就已是希臘化省份拼成的小國，八世紀的生存危機由此埋下伏筆。文化上的長期效應更為持久：祆教作為國家宗教在波斯本土消亡，取代它的是以阿拉伯語為宗教語言、以波斯語為世俗行政語言的新秩序；而波斯被伊斯蘭征服這一敘事本身，在 Bal'ami 的波斯史與 Firdausi 的《列王紀》裡被反覆重寫，成為後世波斯民族主義的源頭之一。
impactEn: This war redrew the political map of the Near East for the seventh century and after. The Sasanian Empire disappeared between 642 and 643, and its territory, tax registers, irrigation works and bureaucratic traditions were taken over wholesale by the caliphate; within seven years the caliphate held the Sasanian Iraq and Persia as well as the Byzantine Syria, Palestine and Egypt, so that the eastern Mediterranean passed from the balance of two empires to the monopoly of a new one, and the Roman and Persian equilibrium was never restored. The Persians did not vanish with the state: Sasanian nobles were enrolled as scribes, generals and local tax officials of the protected population, Persian entered mosque, chancery and medical writing, and the Arabic of the prophetic period acquired an administrative language that could read and write it; the irrigation of Iraq and the tax base of the Tigris gave the new regime the means within a few years to pay a standing army and its siege equipment. The accumulation of siegecraft matters even more technically: across the sieges of Emesa in 634 and Dastgerd in 641 and 642 the Arabs systematically acquired and used siege towers, rams, counterweight throwers and ladders, an art passed on by captured Byzantine and Sasanian engineers and by Nestorian Christian craftsmen, which came to maturity in the siege of Constantinople in 717 and 718 and became a source of the siegecraft of the later Islamic world. For Byzantium, the loss of Mesopotamia and Syria cut away the tax base and the recruiting ground, and the empire of the Holy Roman Emperor had already been reduced by the 630s to a small state of Hellenised provinces, with the crisis of the eighth century planted on that ground. The cultural effects last longer still: Zoroastrianism ceased to exist as a state religion in Persia itself, and was replaced by an order whose religious language was Arabic and whose secular administrative language was Persian. The narrative of the conquest of Persia by Islam was itself rewritten in the Persian history of Bal'ami and in Firdausi's Shahnameh, and became one of the sources of later Persian nationalism.
result: 結果是薩珊國家機器的連續崩潰。al-Qadisiyya（西元636年1月11日）之後，Rustam 陣亡，薩珊在伊拉克的野戰部隊實際上被全滅；同年2月的 al-Nihayyan 擊敗西部總督 Narseh，3月 Ctesiphon 陷落，島上的 al-Mada'i 宮殿群與國庫被掠，5月的 Jalula 之戰擋住波斯貴族的反攻；8月的 al-Zab 會戰是分水嶺，Vahriz 統率的中央軍團全軍覆沒，東部的呼羅珊、波斯本部與 Media 相繼歸附或自行投降，薩珊的國界退到裏海東岸一線。此後數年是掃尾：641至642年 Dastgerd 被圍數月後陷落，雅茲底格三世帶殘部退到 Media、Ray，再退到 Merv，最終在642年被磨坊主所殺，薩珊的皇統斷絕；其子 Peroz 帶著王朝名號繼續抗爭，674年被阿拉伯軍打敗，至676年死於呼羅珊。651年 Abu Muslim 率軍平定東伊朗與呼羅珊的殘餘勢力，戰線推向呼羅珊與河中的門戶，663至676年間的零星抵抗也一一被清剿，薩珊帝國在制度上不再復原。勝方得到的是新的領土與制度：al-Hira 營城在642年遷定 Kufa，Basra 營城落成，兩座兵站成為伊拉克的新政治中心，伊拉克的農業稅與兩河下游的田園成為哈里發國度的主要財源之一；而失敗的萊什國王 al-Nu'man 退到拜占庭邊境。戰爭同時也把阿拉伯帝國的注意力引向敍利亞與拜占庭，634年之後的敍利亞戰線牽住了原可用於東進的兵力，這一安排最終決定了拜占庭在640年代的命運。
resultEn: The result was the successive collapse of the Sasanian state machine. After al-Qadisiyya on 11 January 636 Rustam was killed and the Sasanian field army in Iraq was effectively destroyed; al-Nihayyan in February defeated the western governor Narseh, Ctesiphon fell in March and the palace quarter and treasury on the island of al-Mada'i were sacked, and Jalula in May checked the counter-attack of the Persian nobles. The battle of the Zab in August was the watershed: the central army under Vahriz was wiped out, and Khurasan, the Iranian plateau and Media fell away one after another, by submission or by their own surrender, the Sasanian frontier contracting to a line in the east of the Caspian. The rest was mopping up: Dastgerd was blockaded for months and fell in 641 and 642, Yuzdigird III retreated with what remained of his forces through Media and Ray and then to Merv, where he was killed by a miller in 642 and the royal line was broken; his son Peroz carried the name of the dynasty in continued resistance, was beaten by Arab armies in 674 and was killed in Khurasan in 676. Abu Muslim ended the last resistance in eastern Iran and Khurasan in 651, the frontier moving out to the approaches of Khurasan and Transoxiana, and the scattered revolts between 663 and 676 were suppressed in turn; the Sasanian state was never restored as an institution. The victors gained new territory and a new system: the camp at al-Hira was moved to its permanent site at Kufa in 642, the camp city of Basra was built, and the two garrison towns became the new political centres of Iraq, whose agricultural taxes and the cultivated lands of the lower Tigris became one of the main sources of revenue of the caliphate; and the defeated Lakhmid king al-Nu'man fled to the Byzantine frontier. The war also turned the Arab empire's attention towards Syria and Byzantium: the Syrian front after 634 tied down troops that might otherwise have gone east, and that arrangement decided the fate of Byzantium in the 640s.
